PROLOGUE

The case files

The truth is buried in the mist.

Three files. One mystery.
Open them in order.

Scroll to open
I

The Penny-a-Liner

Paid by the line. Loyal to no paper.

He sells his words to many papers and belongs to none. He knows which editor will print what, and exactly where to send a story so it turns into a myth. A loophole in the system, not a servant to it.

Freelance
II

The Maid

To high society, servants are air.

She sees what he cannot. She knows what normal looks like, so she senses the fracture at once. Her network of household eyes runs deeper than any newsroom ever could. She is his witness. He is her voice.

Informant
III

The City

Fog, lamps, and a horizon worth chasing.

We are building it in Unreal Engine 5, from Shanghai and Toronto. The case is open, and it needs architects, illustrators, and chroniclers to bring the impossible into form.
